text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to put away this book.
There!
Guess now it's time for the next
task.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey! I'm helping the school librarian
out.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The upcoming ticket war is going to be a
long and
bloody affair, so I have to do
whatever I can to
build up my karma!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In other words, she's trying to increase
her luck
for an upcoming ticket raffle.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uh... Digital. Ummm, I-I'm so sorry to
bother you,
but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy! Oh, do you have some more
work for
me? What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you so much! Actually, there
are some
overdue books out that I'd like
to get back.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind coming with me to
collect them
from the people on this
list?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing. Leave all the negotiations to
me,
please.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You're a l-lifesaver! Everyone on the list
is a
trainer, so I was a bit anxious...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It can be a bit unnerving to deal with
adults you
don't know, huh? But I
sometimes deal with
strangers while
engaging with my pastimes, so I'm
used
to it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let's get going then, yeah? Who's first
on the list?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ummm, actually... it's

<username>.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...I had a feeling. All right, Trainer, let's
head to
your office.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Just, wow. I mean, I kinda expected it, but... your desk space is looking like a new layer of the earth's strata.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Could this be the reason you haven't
returned it
yet? I'm sure it's lost
somewhere in this pile...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Well, these things happen... Let's clear
up this
mess. I'll go get some boxes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
All right... Book, stationery, trash, book,
book,
DVD, book, book, trash, pen,
book...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-you're so fast! Organizing everything
by type
without even looking... and
without a single
mistake!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, found the library book. But while
we're at it,
let's get everything put away
into these boxes!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You tidied the place up in the blink of
an eye.
You've even organized all the
books by category
and stored all the
stationery so it's easy to use.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I've got a ton of stuff in my room, so I'm
really
used to storing books and merch
and stuff.
choice_data_list: 片づけが得意なんだな！
片づけが得意なんだね！

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep up the pace and go get the
books from
the other trainers!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Groan... What is going on in those offices? That was certainly no place to bring Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: We're straight up doing archaeological excavations for those overdue books! We managed to tidy things up, but why are all the trainers like that?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
We really cleaned everything up quick.
Or, I
mean, you did... I was mostly
watching... Sorry
about that...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's okay. I was the one who offered to
help in the
first place. Plus, this way, I'm
racking up tons of
karma.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
K-karma? Still, it looks like we've got a
long ways
to go...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I've got to figure something out. If I can't finish everything, my karma's gonna take a hit...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...That's right. Let's change strategies to
just
getting the books back!
choice_data_list: 1人にかける時間を短縮しよう！
地道に片づけていくしかない

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
First, let's make some cards requesting
everyone
return the books. That'll
reduce the time we
spend explaining to
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Then we'll pass out all the cards to the
trainers on
the list. This way, we can split
up the work!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Got it! If it's just passing out cards, I
think I can
do it without getting too
nervous.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I've already got a handle on each
Umamusume's
routine, so that should
help me track down their
trainers! Let's
get these cards out lickety-split!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...My bad on being so late returning the
book.
That said, it's pretty impressive
you managed to
find me in this
underpass, hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And that was the last one. Wow, we
really got
that done quick!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Thank you so much for all of your
help,
Digital. I appreciate it, really.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Spending your days working to build up
good
karma... You're like a hero! I really
look up to
you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hnnngh! Th-that smile... So bright!
Hyuuuuh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(I mustn't tell her I was only doing it to
improve
my odds at scoring tickets! I
can't!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah... Merit-making is something I've
always
tried to make a habit of...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, well... Please try not to overwork
yourself.
Thanks again for all of your
help today. You truly
are a lifesaver!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ha...aaaaagh... Rob Roy's smile... Her
genuine
kindness... Aahh, it sets my
spirit at ease...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Recharge complete! I've basked in the
glory of an
oshi, and I'm back in
business!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Now I can tackle the rest of the cleaning
we put
aside!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Book collection and housekeeping,
check and
check! Honestly, there were a
few places I
thought would be faster to
just burn down and
rebuild from scratch,
but I'm glad to be finished!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Seriously?! You finished the whole list and went back to clean their offices?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Despite how tired you were
before, you still
worked your magic!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A smile like yours would spring me back
to life
countless times!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what a line! You're like the main
character
from an Umamusume hero
series!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hwah! The way your eyes shine is... s-so
cute...
Truly, the greatest reward there
is...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Th-this isn't costing me any of my
good
karma, is it? It's a freebie, right?!
